items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

ctx.x: But some people tune them like four string banjo or something too. Yeah. I think Eddie Conlon knew. No, I tune them on a regular Spanish guitar sound. In the old days in New Orleans, did they use mostly banjo or guitar when you were a kid? First, can you remember that?

Well, they used banjo. They used guitar. Of course they used guitar quite a lot too, you know. The guitar was just starting to come in really. And when I left New Orleans, I went up north and everybody was playing guitar. That was it.
